purpose: One preregistered complete finite physical-catalogue CDF stress test, without a word-depth or valuation cap. No asymptotic inference.
profile: Exact first-arrival length k, valuation total A, maximum letter a; slope=2^A/3^k with exact Fraction comparison

termination_policy.timeout: unknown, never classify as no hit
termination_policy.no_hit_certificate: A directly verified path reaches1 without the target, and S(1)=1 with all targets>1

catalogue_validation: Memoized catalogues checked against independent forward enumeration from every registered source; all target paths checked to1
matching: Ascending exact slope keys with physical source tie-break; match smallest available image when admissible, skipping unmatchable sources; capacity m per physical image. Complete catalogue optimum also via rank matching if capacity sufficient.
measurements: Physical odd and dyadically lifted ordinary counts
Incoming load and exact maximum actual height
Selected fraction of the full physical catalogue
Minimal full slope dilation and minimal full physical height by sorted rank
Fraction using valuations≤6, solely as finite representability diagnostic
checks: Every normal/optimized run must have identical JSON bytes
No unresolved source allowed for a complete claim
All pair target basins disjoint in finite certified data
All exact catalogue and height inequalities checked with integer/Fraction guards
resource_policy: Local CPU only; no GPU or paid resource needed
result_interpretation: Finite benchmark only. Positive fractions at these cutoffs do not imply η or H; negative truncated capacity does not imply an asymptotic no-go.
